items.en: Consider a lie to answer with...
"He would have killed me without hesitation, given the chance." (lie)
"I didn't like him. That's why." (lie)
"His anti-technological terrorism is a threat to the future of the Persean Sector." (lie)
"He was a brute who ruled through terror." (lie)
"Because he's a Pather. It's what all Pathers deserve." (lie)
"His manner and actions pollute the purity of the Path." (lie)
Consider telling the truth, instead...
"So are you thinking about killing me?"
Speak of other things
"I'm glad we cleared that up."
"I'm not sure yet."
"In due time."
"No. You seem different."
"He was a murderer. The world is better off without him."
"How can you criticize me while Pathers raid and kill?"
"That's rich coming from a Pather. Remember Mairaath?"
"I am not responsible for what others choose."
"And they will die too, if they choose murder and terrorism."
"You can't simply dismiss Mairaath, and what the Path did there."
"So be it."
"Not so much once a few are made example of."
"Will you tell me where he is?"
Let it hang; he knows what you want
"Archcurate Jaspis wants him back. To serve her. To serve the Church."
"Whatever his mission was, it's over. The archcurate is... worried about him."
"Well, I don't get paid if I don't return with him. Or his body."
"My apologies. It's just spacer humor."
"It's a job. I'm simply being realistic."
"I don't negotiate with terrorists. My fleet is in orbit."
"I have a battalion of marines in orbit. Make this easy on yourself."
"And why is that."
"That wasn't so hard, was it."
"Why help the Church? Are you not of a... wayward sect?"
"How does this serve the Path, for me to find Bornanew for the Church?"
"That's it? Nothing about 'the Path'?"
"Why would you, a Pather, help me with this?"
"You have my thanks; may a path of peace lay before you."
"Just like that? Is this some kind of trap?"
"One more thing- I need to find Brother Cotton."
"Thank you. And for the tea."
"Do you have a problem with Cotton?"
"'Will not' help me, you mean."
"Well, thank you anyway. And for the tea."
Prepare a raid on Virens' compounds to extract Jethro Bornanew
Go to the brig
"I'm looking for Jethro Bornanew."
"Who told you I'm looking for Jethro Bornanew."
"So where is he?"
"Guard, get this man some tea."
Have a sip of tea
"It looks like I just walked all over your 'path', huh."
"So you're not going to call me a servant of Moloch? Spawn of Mammon?"
"You don't sound like much of a Pather."
"Do you know Brother Cotton?"
"I need to speak with Brother Cotton. To give him a message."
"Send him a message. Tell him I need to meet with him."
Pour the tea.
Let him pour.
"Guard, remove those cuffs."
"He met with Sedge."
Let him tell it

"That wasn't so hard."

Approach the grove
"Jethro Bornanew, I presume."
"Did you lose someone?"
"I'm taking you back to Gilead."
"Come on then, let's go." (leave)
"Can I call you 'Jeff'?"
"What happened with infiltrating the Path? You had a mission."
"Why does Jaspis want you back so badly?
"Is that your farm?"
"If you like, I can have found you dead here."
"Wait- what was that about the 'song of angels'?"
"Ludd was thus blessed."
"It sounds like a neurological issue."
"I see."
"There was a time I heard... distant music. Like a choir."
"I have heard... distant music. Like a choir. Wasn't in telemetry."
"It's been said that Brother Livewell Cotton hears music. 'A choir of angels', those were the words."
"Brother Livewell Cotton told me he has heard music. A 'choir of angels', he said."
"I heard the music when we encountered a strange ship. It used exotic technologies unknown to even the Domain."
"I heard the music when we scanned the Gates, the Domain Gates, using a new method."
"That ship, the Ziggurat, is in orbit. In my fleet."
"What am I supposed to do with a 'fearful omen'?"
"Walk the Path of Light? That doesn't help."
"I will try to walk the path of light. When the time comes."
"'Path of light'? Brother Cotton told me the same thing."
"Let us speak of other things."
"Never mind. It's not important now."
"I have traversed the Gates. A lesser crossing, but I have the technology."
"The Gates are a gift, Bornanew. We should use them."
"The Gates are dangerous. They must be studied carefully."
"Just as well, because I intend to avoid them."
"Just as well, because I intend to avoid them." (lie)
"Jeff it is. More efficient."
"Jeff it is. It's less... you know."
"I'm not being serious. Your name is Jethro."
"Sedge?"
"Sedge? Don't worry, I killed him."
"Sedge."
"Don't worry, I killed Sedge."
"The deed is done. Or not done, in your case. Let it go."
"But you're not him. That's why Jaspis wants you back."
"You'll have to learn to be a lot less squeamish if you're to be a Knight."
"Aren't you a Knight Initiate? How can you be so squeamish?"
"Don't worry about it."
"You could try 'thank you'."
"Look, this one was on me. Don't worry about it."
"See? This is why you're the man for whatever Jaspis is up to."
"It gets easier with practice."
"You're worrying about it. I told you not to."
"... You're welcome."
"But you're just one person."
"People died for me to find you."
"I shot a man to find you."
"No one else seems to think much of you."
"She's getting a bit old."
"That's not important now. I have a mission to complete."
"Yes. In conflicts between the powerful, that's how it works."
"No. I may have overreacted."
"An admirable cause."
"A hopeless dream."
Say nothing.
"Feeling okay?"
Give him a moment
"Don't die for real on me, now."
"Yes. Just say the word."
"Of course. I just need a body to substitute." (look pointedly at the graves)
"I'm afraid I cannot. The Archcurate gave me a mission and I intend to complete it."
"No. You must live for yourself now."
"You should. It will help. She was... emotional."
"It is. Burn bright, burn long." (leave)
"It is. Blessed be your path." (leave)
"It is. Keep your head down." (leave)
And about the body...
"I found Bornanew."
"I have his body for you." (lie)
"I told him I would tell you he is dead."
"Mine."
"His."
"It doesn't matter."
"I gave you the truth. Is that not enough?"
"I accept that failure because I have freed a man."
"Do you want me to go kidnap him?"
"Would it make you happy if I shot Bornanew and brought back his body?"
"I found Bornanew. He's here, with my $shipOrFleet."

"Yes, I've heard of the Yaribays."
"My, uh, thoughts exactly."
"You've done your research. Tell me about Menes Yaribay himself."
"How did a Kazeron aristocrat get put in charge of Olinadu?"
"Tell me more about the relic at the center of this. What is it?"
"Wait, why's the real glove on Tartessus if Ludd removed it on Gilead?"
"What's the plan? Ask Menes nicely for the glove?"
"Kumari Kandam? You were on Chalcedon. With the Path."
"And you don't think it's real? The original, I mean."
"Seems like a lot to get worked up about."
"What's Ludd going to do with two right-hand gloves?"
"Let's try to focus on the matter, ah, at hand."
"No need to apologize. I can't help but agree."
"But magic isn't real. So what harm is focusing on a glove, fake relic or not?"
"But you think he might listen to someone like me."
"We could offer to buy it."
"We could steal it."
"I could talk to Horus Yaribay. He leads his gens, presumably."
"To Olinadu, then."
"My repute?"
"Just one problem- the League wants me shot on sight."
"It won't be a problem."
"It might be a problem."
"'Roguish charm', huh?"
"To Olinadu, then."
"I understand that you're a collector of interesting objects."
"What I've experienced in the depths of the starry sea would drive lesser minds to madness."
"I took my ship to reach the stars.... but I've gone much, much farther than that."
